claims.statement: Management states that they will not earn more than 15% margin.
claims.quote: We are very clear, we'll not earn more than 15% or thereabouts.

claims.statement: Neville Noronha notes that private label operations are a long game and what they have set out to achieve will probably take a decade.
claims.quote: Like I said, it's a long game. Private label is, I mean, what we have set out to achieve will probably take a decade.

facts.statement: DMart store sizes hover around 40,000 square feet and the company plans to continue with that size.
facts.quote: All our stores more or less hover around 40,000 square feet. And we will continue to be around that space.

facts.statement: DMart's employee attrition fell by almost 2% to 3%, moving from 13.9% to 11.3%.
facts.quote: DMart employee attrition actually has fallen from last year, which we have published, I think it's fallen by almost 2% to 3%, from 13.9% to 11.3%.
